metadata.title: Help & bug reports — NebulaCoop
metadata.description: Common problems, error codes and bug reports.

page.paragraph_2: Common problems, error codes and bug reports.

troubleshooting.paragraph_1: No matching topics. Try another word or report the problem below.
troubleshooting.paragraph_2: NebulaCoop needs Super Mario Galaxy for Wii, revision 0: North America (RMGE01), Europe (RMGP01) or Japan (RMGJ01). Modified or patched disc images fail the check.
troubleshooting.paragraph_3: Lower the internal resolution or the interpolation target, use an upscaler, or choose the Performance preset.
troubleshooting.paragraph_5: Reconnect the controller and set Input to Auto on the CONTROLS page. The Switch 2 Pro Controller needs the WinUSB driver on Windows.
troubleshooting.paragraph_7: DLSS needs an NVIDIA RTX GPU and a one-time download from NVIDIA, then a restart. The SYSTEM page shows what this computer supports.
troubleshooting.paragraph_8: Turn the mods off on the MODS page (on Windows, you can also hold Shift while NebulaCoop starts), then turn them on one at a time.
troubleshooting.paragraph_10: Update your graphics driver. On a PC with two graphics cards, choose the other one under Graphics card on the SYSTEM page. If an error code appears, look it up below.
troubleshooting.paragraph_11: 4K movies need hardware video decoding. Use a lower-resolution video.
troubleshooting.paragraph_12: Close programs using a lot of CPU time and try again. Include your hardware and background programs if the issue continues.
troubleshooting.paragraph_13: Check the dated saves-backup folders beside your saves folder. To bring a save back, use Import saves on the GENERAL page instead of copying files.
troubleshooting.paragraph_15: Download NebulaCoop only from its GitHub releases. It isn’t code-signed yet: if Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, choose More info, then Run anyway. If an antivirus flags a file, ask in Discord before you run it.

error-codes.paragraph_1: When NebulaCoop stops, it shows an error code and saves a report.

report.paragraph_1: Search the existing issues first. For a new problem, include the steps that cause it and what you expected.
report.item_2: Operating system, CPU, GPU and graphics driver version.
report.item_3: Galaxy and mission, plus the exact steps to reproduce the problem.
report.item_4: Graphics settings you changed and all enabled mods.
report.item_5: A screenshot or video for visual problems.
report.paragraph_2: For a crash, attach the newest .txt and .dmp files from
report.paragraph_3: on Windows. Report co-op problems to NebulaCoop, not to Nebula.
report.paragraph_4: For a visual or timing problem, choose Record next to Diagnostics on the SYSTEM page, play until it happens, then attach the files from the diagnostics folder.
